full_judgment: 2. The short fact relevant for disposal of the Rule is that the suit property is Rowafata Rowa beel, measuring 89.99 acres ofland under Sadar Thana of Sunamganj District, originally belonged to Dewan Aftabur Reza Chowdhury Waqf Estate, subsequently Government acquired 12 annas share of the case fisheries under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950; the appellant-petitioner as Joint Mutwalli of Dewan Aftabur Reza Waqf Estate obtained the lease in the said 12 annas share of government portion in the year of 1973 corresponding to 1380 BS at a rental of Taka 3,000; since the 4 annas share of the Waqf Estate is not acquired, the CA/Roll is not finally published and thereafter the said order has been extended from time to time by the Government. Thereafter cancelled the said lease by the Memo No. SA/Char-1/95/1986 dated 5·7·1995 on the ground of non- payment of rent from 1395 as to 1401 BS The plaintiff-petitioner then filed writ petition No.1 540 of 1995 challenging the said cancellation order vide Memo No.SA/Char-1/195/1986 dated 5-7-1995 and Memo No. SA/Char-1/95/1973 (1) dated 2-7-1995 and the tender notification under notification Memo No. SA1/Chaf/1/5/95/1995(200) dated 6-7-1995 and obtained the Rule along with stay and the Deputy Commissioner, Sunamganj was directed to accept rent only for the year 1402 as from the petitioner. During the pendency of the said Rule the present petitioner filed Title Suit No,44 of 2000 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Sunamganj for declaration that the above Memo dated 5-7-1995, 2-7-1995 and 6-7-1995 were illegal, void and not binding upon the plaintiff. The High Court Division discharged the Rule by the judgment and order dated 3-11-2003; Title Suit No,44 of 2000 was also dismissed by the judgment and Decree dated 16-6-2005 passed by the Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Sunamganj.
